title: Assistance Coordination Note: Lowering Share of a Patient Payment Plan Installment by Household Screening
content:
On a **Patient Payment Plan** installment change, the lowering share follows the open application's screening. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

**Rule.** The lowering share is 50 percent for a household screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 75 percent for one screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose lowest requested percentage of the computed installment is higher; otherwise it is the tier's lowest requested percentage.

| Tier | Tier's lowest requested percentage | At or below 200% FPL | Above 200%, at or below 400% FPL | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 100 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 100 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 100 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 100 | 50 | 75 | 100 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 75 | 50 | 75 | 75 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 50 | 50 | 50 | 50 |

**Hypothetical.** Against a current installment of 160.00 on a tier at 100 percent: at 190 percent FPL the share figure is 80.00; at 260 percent it is 120.00; at 420 percent it is 160.00.
